name: Business Logic Errors (advisory)
absence_requirements: Validate quantities and amounts server-side: reject negative or zero quantities, negative prices, and amounts beyond sane bounds — a client can send any value.
Compute prices, discounts, and totals on the SERVER from trusted data; never trust a client-supplied price, total, or discount amount.
Enforce the state machine: only allow valid status transitions (e.g. cannot refund an unpaid order, cannot re-use a one-time coupon), and check them server-side.
Authorize every state-changing action against the acting user — confirm they own the resource and are allowed this transition (ties to CWE-862/639).
Enforce limits (redemptions, quota, rate) atomically on the server, not by a client flag or a separate read.
attack_scenario: the client controls a value the server should own — a negative quantity credits the account, a client-supplied price undercuts the real one, or a coupon is redeemed twice — turning normal input into free money or privilege
negative_test_hint: submit "quantity=-1" (and a client-supplied price of 0, and the same coupon twice) and assert the server rejects each and computes totals itself

exemplar.compliant:
qty = int(request.json["qty"])
if qty <= 0:
    abort(400)
price = Product.objects.get(id=pid).price   # server-owned
charge(user, price * qty)
exemplar.explanation: derive money and quantities from trusted server data with explicit bounds checks; never let the client set the price or a negative quantity
